codegraph.cold_start_quirk: VERIFIED 2026-06-16: serves 4 tools (codegraph_search/explore/node/files) reliably WHEN its background daemon is warm. A COLD first call (no daemon running, e.g. right after a host/gateway restart) returns 0 tools while the daemon spins up, then self-heals on subsequent calls. Daemon binds to the indexed dir (/usr/local/lib/hermes-agent). NOT a cwd bug — earlier 'cwd-sensitive' hypothesis was wrong. Mitigation if cold-start matters: warm the daemon on boot (codegraph daemon/serve) before first agent use.
